summary: Einride AB (Swedish issuer, filed Form 6-K) announced a merger agreement to acquire Flipturn, Inc. via its wholly owned subsidiary Merger Sub. The aggregate closing consideration is ~$38.4M in Company ADSs, with up to ~$33M in earnout consideration also payable in ADSs based on milestones. Consideration is stock-only; no price per share or premium is disclosed. The deal requires Flipturn stockholder approval, typical closing conditions, and is expected to close in Q3 2026. Outstanding Flipturn stock options will be assumed and converted. The ADSs issued are unregistered, restricted, and subject to a lock-up that releases 25% after one month if the ADS price is at or above $9.20. What to watch: stock price performance relative to the lock-up threshold and regulatory clearance.
